name: Andrzej Halicki, Matjaž Nemec - Après le § 45 - Am 122
title: REPORT on the Council position on the draft general budget of the European Union for the financial year 2026
part_text: 45 a. Stresses that the Union’s food security and sovereignty constitute essential components of its strategic autonomy and that the budget must support the Union’s agriculture and fisheries sectors, in particular family farms, young farmers and fishers, in order to enable them to produce food in a profitable, competitive and sustainable manner; underlines the essential role of the Common Agricultural Policy (CAP) in increasing productivity through technological progress, in ensuring a fair standard of living for farmers and in guaranteeing food security; firmly rejects, in this regard, any reduction of the CAP budget in constant euros;
